issues.title: Test file separated from hook
issues.description: The rule requires test files to be co-located with their corresponding component files in the same directory. The test file use-state-favicon.test.ts was moved to ui-v2/src/__tests__/hooks/ instead of remaining in ui-v2/src/hooks/ with the hook file use-state-favicon.ts.
issues.rule_name: React Component Test Files Must Be Co-Located

issues.title: Incorrect falsy value handling for run_count displays wrong value for zero
issues.description: The run_count display uses the logical OR operator (||) instead of the nullish coalescing operator (??). This causes a bug when run_count is explicitly 0 (a valid value indicating the task has not been retried). When run_count is 0, the || operator treats it as falsy and displays the fallback value '0' instead of the actual value 0 from the API. While the visual output is the same, this semantic error means the code doesn't distinguish between 'no data' (null/undefined) and 'zero retries' (0), which could cause issues if the UI behavior needs to differentiate these states in the future or if the fallback value changes.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
<dl className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-2">
	<dt className="text-gray-500">Run Count</dt>
	<dd className="">{taskRun.run_count || 0}</dd>
</dl>

issues.title: Missing type coercion for retries value causes potential type inconsistency
issues.description: The retries display removes the .toString() call that was present in the original PR, directly rendering taskRun.empirical_policy?.retries ?? "0". This creates a type inconsistency where the value could be either a number (when retries exists) or a string "0" (when it doesn't). While React can render both, this inconsistency violates the principle of uniform data handling and could cause issues in the component tree if parent or child components expect consistent string formatting for this field, or if the value is later used in string operations or comparisons.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
<dl className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-2">
	<dt className="text-gray-500">Retries</dt>
	<dd className="">
		{taskRun.empirical_policy?.retries ?? "0"}
	</dd>
</dl>

issues.title: Incorrect truthy check for retry_jitter_factor hides valid zero values
issues.description: The retry_jitter_factor check was changed from an explicit null/undefined check to a simple truthy check. This is a critical bug because a jitter factor of 0 is a valid configuration value (meaning no randomness in retry delays), but the truthy check treats 0 as falsy and displays "None" instead. This misrepresents the actual task configuration to users, making them think no jitter factor is set when it's actually configured to 0. The original PR correctly distinguished between 'not set' (null/undefined) and 'set to zero' (0), but this change breaks that distinction.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
<dl className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-2">
	<dt className="text-gray-500">Retry Jitter Factor</dt>
	<dd className="">
		{taskRun.empirical_policy?.retry_jitter_factor
			? taskRun.empirical_policy.retry_jitter_factor.toString()
			: "None"}
	</dd>
</dl>

issues.title: Missing test file for new use-state-favicon hook violates repository testing rules
issues.description: A new hook use-state-favicon.ts was added without a corresponding test file. This directly violates AGENTS.md Rule #10 requiring test files to be co-located with their components/hooks, and ui-v2/src/hooks/AGENTS.md which states 'Code, test, and related files should be in the same directory'. The ui-v2/AGENTS.md also explicitly requires 'Always write tests for new components and hooks' as a quality standard. All other hooks in the directory have test files (use-page-title.test.ts, use-stepper.test.ts, etc.), making this omission a clear violation of established patterns and explicit repository rules.

issues.title: Flow run link displays empty or undefined text when flow_run_name is missing
issues.description: The condition for displaying the flow run link was changed from checking both flow_run_id AND flow_run_name to only checking flow_run_id. When a task run has a flow_run_id but flow_run_name is null or undefined (which is valid according to the UITaskRun schema where flow_run_name is 'string | null | undefined'), the link will render with empty text or display 'undefined'. This creates a broken user experience where users see a clickable link with no visible text. The original code correctly ensured both values existed before showing the link.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #19951 - feat(ui-v2): improve task run details page parity with Vue
pr.author: unknown

structured_output.summary:
This PR brings the React task run details page closer to the legacy Vue UI. It adds a copy button to the Task Inputs JSON, sets the browser tab title through the existing `usePageTitle` hook, adds a new `useStateFavicon` hook with seven state SVGs, points the breadcrumb at `/runs?tab=task-runs`, and changes the details sidebar so empty fields render "None" instead of disappearing. The breadcrumb search param and the favicon element IDs in `index.html` both check out.

The main problems are in the details sidebar and the favicon hook. Retry Jitter Factor now treats a legitimate `0` as missing and shows "None". The favicon hook points at SVG files that don't exist for CANCELLING and PAUSED, which turns the favicon into a 404. The PR description also says `useStateFavicon` has 10 tests, but no test file exists in the diff or the repo, and the existing details tests don't cover the new "None" rendering.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The Retry Jitter Factor regression is a real display bug that changes correct data into a misleading "None". The favicon hook requests non-existent assets for two state types. The PR claims test coverage for the new hook that isn't present. The remaining items are minor, and the rest of the change is sound.

architecture.overview:
The task run details page is `TaskRunDetailsPage` in `ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details-page/index.tsx`. It reads the task run with `useSuspenseQuery` and renders a header with breadcrumbs, a tabbed body (Logs, Artifacts, Task Inputs, Details), and a sidebar that renders `TaskRunDetails` from `task-run-details/task-run-details.tsx`. Page-level side effects such as the document title and favicon are handled by small hooks in `src/hooks`, which write directly to `document`.

This PR adds two hook calls at the top of the page component: `usePageTitle` sets `document.title`, and the new `useStateFavicon` swaps the favicon `<link>` elements declared in `index.html` for an SVG named after the task run state. The PR also changes the breadcrumb link, adds the copy button to `JsonInput`, and rewrites the sidebar so each field is always rendered and shows "None" when empty.
steps: Entry point: the route renders `TaskRunDetailsPage`, which fetches the task run with `useSuspenseQuery` and passes it down to the header, tabs, and sidebar.

Browser side effects: `usePageTitle` and `useStateFavicon` run in the page component. The favicon hook reads `state_type`, swaps the `favicon-16`/`favicon-32` (or `-dark`) link hrefs for `/<state>.svg`, and restores the default icons on cleanup.
Header: the breadcrumb's Runs link now carries `search={{ tab: "task-runs" }}`, which matches the `tab` enum in the runs route's `validateSearch`.
Task Inputs: `JsonInput` gets the existing `copy` prop, so the copy button is rendered from the shared component with no new logic.

Details sidebar: `TaskRunDetails` changes from conditional rendering to always rendering each `<dl>`, falling back to "None". Most fields are handled correctly, but the Retry Jitter Factor truthiness check treats 0 as empty.
Assets: seven state SVGs are added to `ui-v2/public`. CANCELLING and PAUSED have no icon, so the favicon hook will request a missing file for those states.

findings.title: Retry Jitter Factor of 0 is shown as "None"
findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details/task-run-details.tsx`, the Retry Jitter Factor `<dd>` (around lines 177-183) uses a truthiness check on `taskRun.empirical_policy?.retry_jitter_factor`, so a valid value of `0` renders as "None". Change the condition to an explicit null/undefined check (`!== null && !== undefined`), matching how the Duration and Estimated Run Time fields in the same file already handle numeric values. Make sure `0` renders as "0".

findings.title: Favicon hook requests missing SVGs for CANCELLING and PAUSED
findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/hooks/use-state-favicon.ts`, the `if (stateType)` block (around lines 49-53) builds `/${stateType.toLowerCase()}.svg` for every state. CANCELLING and PAUSED have no SVG in `ui-v2/public`, so the favicon 404s for those states. Either add `cancelling.svg` and `paused.svg` to `ui-v2/public` following the style of the existing state icons, or restrict the href update to states that have an icon, leaving the default favicon in place for the rest. Keep the cleanup behavior unchanged.

findings.title: PR says useStateFavicon has 10 tests, but none are in the diff or repo
findings.body:
The PR description says "Added comprehensive test coverage for `useStateFavicon` hook (10 test cases)". The diff does not include any test file, and searching `ui-v2/src` finds no `use-state-favicon.test.*`. The sibling `use-page-title.test.ts` exists, so the pattern is there to follow. The description overstates what was delivered.

The existing `task-run-details.test.tsx` also has no coverage for the new "None" rendering or for the 0 jitter value, which is why the regression above isn't caught.
findings.fixPrompt: Add `ui-v2/src/hooks/use-state-favicon.test.ts`, modeled on `ui-v2/src/hooks/use-page-title.test.ts`. It should cover: setting both favicon-16 and favicon-32 hrefs to `/<state>.svg` for a state, reading the dark-scheme elements when `prefers-color-scheme: dark` is mocked via `window.matchMedia`, leaving the default icons when `stateType` is null or undefined, and restoring the default hrefs on unmount. The description says 10 tests exist, so either add them or correct the PR description. Also extend `ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details/task-run-details.test.tsx` with cases for the "None" fallbacks and for `retry_jitter_factor: 0` rendering as "0".

findings.title: Flow Run link can render with an empty name
findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details/task-run-details.tsx`, the Flow Run `<Link>` (around lines 45-58) renders `taskRun.flow_run_name` as its text. The condition was loosened from `flow_run_name && flow_run_id` to `flow_run_id` alone, so a null name yields an unlabeled link. Add a fallback for the link text, for example the flow run ID, so the link always has a visible label.

findings.title: Favicon reset paths differ from the paths declared in index.html
findings.body:
The favicon links in `index.html` point to `/ico/favicon-16x16.png` and similar paths. On cleanup, the hook restores `/favicon-16x16.png` and `/favicon-16x16-dark.png` from the public root. Both files exist, so nothing breaks, but the restored icon may not be the one that was originally declared. Keeping the initial hrefs in the hook would make the reset exact.

::diff{file="ui-v2/src/hooks/use-state-favicon.ts" lines="56-63"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `ui-v2/src/hooks/use-state-favicon.ts`, the cleanup (around lines 56-63) restores favicons to `/favicon-16x16.png` and friends, but `ui-v2/index.html` declares `/ico/favicon-*.png`. Capture each element's original `href` before the first change and restore that value on cleanup, so the reset matches what the page declares.

findings.title: Breadcrumb now links to the Task Runs tab
findings.body:
The breadcrumb's Runs link now passes `search={{ tab: "task-runs" }}`. The runs route in `ui-v2/src/routes/runs/index.tsx` defines `tab` as `z.enum(["flow-runs", "task-runs"])`, so this is a valid search value and the link lands on the right tab.

::code{file="ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details-page/index.tsx" lines="191-200"}

findings.title: Favicon element IDs match index.html
findings.body: The hook looks up `favicon-16`, `favicon-32`, `favicon-16-dark`, and `favicon-32-dark`. All four exist in `ui-v2/index.html` with those IDs. The checklist item can be marked as verified.

findings.title: Page title reuses the existing usePageTitle hook
findings.body:
The page title is set with the existing `usePageTitle` hook instead of a new mechanism, and the fallback to "Task Run" before the name loads matches the hook's documented null-handling. The page component's existing pattern is followed.

::code{file="ui-v2/src/components/task-runs/task-run-details-page/index.tsx" lines="72-76"}

findings.title: Copy button reuses JsonInput's existing copy prop
findings.body:
The Task Inputs copy button is enabled with the `copy` prop on the existing `JsonInput`, so no new UI code is needed. The prop is already implemented at `ui-v2/src/components/ui/json-input.tsx`.
